Cancellation flow review - 'StreamNest Premium' (video streaming)

Tester path from Settings > Subscription > Cancel:
Step 1: 'Are you sure? You'll lose your downloads.' [Keep Premium] [Continue]
Step 2: 'Before you go, get 50% off for 3 months!' [Claim offer] [No thanks, continue]
Step 3: 'Tell us why you're leaving' (required multiple choice, 6 options)
Step 4: 'Cancel subscription' opens the store's subscription management page, where the tester canceled.
Total time: 70 seconds.

Store policy 3.8 Cancellation:
(a) If an app offers its own cancellation entry point, it must lead to cancellation without more than one retention offer.
(b) Apps may not require users to provide a reason before cancelling.
(c) Apps may not use misleading button labels in the cancellation flow.
(d) Linking to the store's subscription management page satisfies the cancellation requirement.

Feature: Shows live location of family members on a map. Parents can add a child's device by scanning a QR code on it; adults can add another adult by sending an invite.
